描述_EN: this vessel was probably used in graves; similar examples were found in tombs of the liao dynasty in the outskirts of beijing. this tall vase is an example of ware produced during the liao (907-1125) or jin dynasty (1115-1234) and is characterised by a buff stoneware body covered with a variegated brown and black glaze.
描述_ZN: this vessel was probably used in graves; similar examples were found in tombs of the liao dynasty in the outskirts of beijing. 这个高大的花瓶是辽代（907-1125）或金代（1115-1234）生产的器物的例子，其特点是在水色的石器上覆盖着斑斓的棕色和黑色的釉。
